def: Add the two bases, halve it, then multiply by the height.
defEs: Suma las dos bases, toma la mitad y multiplica por la altura.
alt: Illustration of Area of Trapezoids: Add the two bases, halve it, then multiply by the height.

def: A shape with four sides and just one pair of parallel sides.
defEs: Una figura de cuatro lados con un solo par de lados paralelos.
alt: Illustration of Trapezoid: A shape with four sides and just one pair of parallel sides.

def: Lines that stay the same distance apart and never meet.
defEs: Líneas que siempre están a la misma distancia y nunca se cruzan.
alt: Illustration of Parallel: Lines that stay the same distance apart and never meet.

def: A side of a trapezoid. It is one of two parallel sides.
defEs: Un lado de un trapecio. Es uno de los dos lados paralelos.
alt: Illustration of Base 1 (b1): A side of a trapezoid. It is one of two parallel sides.

def: A side of a trapezoid. It is the other parallel side.
defEs: Un lado de un trapecio. Es el otro lado paralelo.
alt: Illustration of Base 2 (b2): A side of a trapezoid. It is the other parallel side.

def: How tall it is, measured straight up from the base.
defEs: Qué tan alta es, medida en línea recta hacia arriba desde la base.
alt: Illustration of Height: How tall it is, measured straight up from the base.

def: Lines that meet at a square corner (90°).
defEs: Líneas que se cruzan en una esquina cuadrada (90°).

def: How much flat space a shape covers.
defEs: Cuánto espacio plano cubre una figura.
alt: Illustration of Area: How much flat space a shape covers.
